blocks.text: Indonesia prepares to welcome the 2024 election, followed by the rise of the new Orde ideological platform under Soeharto's authoritarian government. The rise of a presidential candidate with close ties to Orba... sparked concern for the return to dark times full of repression and limitation of human rights.

One of the real examples of Orba's repression was President No. 14 / 1967's instructions to ban Chinese festivities. This policy reflects discrimination and systemic human rights violations against Chinese ethnicities in Indonesia. This Orba Darkness was later wiped out by Gus Dur, the fourth president of Indonesia, through Principal Number 6 in 2000 who pulled Inpress No. 14 / 1967.

The spirit of the democratization of Gus Dur became a symbol of resistance to Orba's repression. Gus Dur, a humanitarian fighter and pluralism, advanced tolerance and equality for all society groups. His bravery against discrimination and authoritarianism, Orba became an example to young people in preserving democracy.

At the 2024 election, Gus Dur's spirit must be reopened. We must reject the return of Orba with all forms of repression and discrimination. Support for a couple of interconnected presidential candidates with Orba means endangering democracy and bringing Indonesia back to dark times.

Let us preserve democracy by choosing a leader who is committed to tolerance, pluralism and human rights. Don't let the shadow of Orba haunt the future of Indonesia. The spirit of Gus Dur against repression and discrimination must be an inspiration for all of us to continue to fight for fair and prosperous democracy.
Let us realize democratic, tolerant and prosperous Indonesia by refusing the return of Orba in the 2024 elections.
